audit_scope: Selected computational mechanism statements and surrounding arguments from the four complete materialized traditional PDFs; runtime/source-test crosswalk, not an independent full proof audit or Lean replay. Every chapter is inventoried; selected theorem groups are mapped explicitly.

sources.title: AVOC: Artifact value, guarded operations, and calibrated planning
Finite Integration: Exact transport, Fubini, and certified quadrature
Cartier Compilers: Normalized generating functions, local masks, digit states, and prime-power realizations
Sufficient Resolution: Exact reduction, hidden memory, and certified reconstruction

mechanisms.summary: Fiber-constant task sufficiency, decoders, joint queries and finite information ordering.
boundaries: Exhaustive aligned finite tables and finite query families, with hashable labels whose equality is reflexive and returns a scalar Python bool; NaN and ambiguous equality are rejected. A sampled table establishes only sample-domain sufficiency. Explicit default_target declares a nonempty target-codomain member on an empty raw domain or unreachable observations.
Information equivalence compares retained distinctions, not shortest encoding, acquisition cost or efficient decoder complexity.

mechanisms.summary: Exact rational observation channels, garbling and finite policy-value maximization.
boundaries: Finite rational row-stochastic channels, normalized nonnegative rational priors and finite nonempty action menus. The source also allows arbitrary rational weights for some structural identities; this API deliberately validates probability priors.

Exact observation/action scores include impossible observations without division by predictive mass. Scientific bounds concern the declared channel/utility table, not estimated probabilities or physical evidence.

mechanisms.summary: Bayesian conditioning and likelihood-preserving compression.
boundaries: Runtime uses binary64 probabilities and positive evidence, while the paper has exact rational arithmetic and a prior fallback on impossible observations.

mechanisms.summary: Transition-closed state quotients preserve every finite controlled Bellman value.
boundaries: Numerical fixed-chain lumping and filtering are present; rational rewards, action families and guarded Bellman values are absent.

mechanisms.summary: Data-only propositional derivations and exact generation-bound artifact admission.
boundaries: Described Lean checker/receipt model is outside this Python runtime; hashes and provenance records are not proof-checker substitutes.

mechanisms.summary: Eight-bit complete Boolean semantics, bounded grammar search and cost-preserving compaction.
boundaries: Exact three-input tree grammar and eager node tariff only; full syntax materialization is resource bounded, and incomplete affordable search prefixes certify only their examined prefix. Compaction counts one declared semantic-index lookup per candidate; host allocation and hardware timing are excluded.

mechanisms.summary: Attained lower-cost certificate bank for all 256 Boolean signatures.
boundaries: All 256 exact witnesses and all 196608 ordered binary plus 256 unary constructor inequalities are checked. By AVOC Theorem 6.4 an accepted bank attains global minima over all finite trees in the declared three-input grammar and eager node tariff; arbitrary programs, shared circuit DAGs and physical runtime are outside scope. Proposed or incomplete banks are untrusted until fresh exhaustive validation.

mechanisms.summary: Dimensioned exact affine coefficients, composition and zero-and-basis completeness.
boundaries: ExactAffineMap supplies rational affine composition; expression normal forms cover typed rational linear maps, not the full affine program language or a dedicated affine probe checker.

mechanisms.summary: Fusion tariffs, certified minimum-width affine factorization with LAH=I and offset retargeting.
boundaries: Matrix-chain planning and low-rank factors have different comparator classes; no exact affine upper/lower rank witness or protected retargeting bank is exposed.

mechanisms.summary: Exact finite-horizon adaptive planning with state-dependent admissibility and staged acquisition.
boundaries: Exhaustive finite state tables with nonempty state-dependent action lists and a common finite observation alphabet. The paper permits an infinite state space; this implementation does not expose that general evaluator.

Exact horizon tables are bounded by preflight update/output caps and intermediate rational-bit limits; exceeded limits raise ResourceLimitError. All successors are validated, including zero-probability branches. The staged workflow starts both artifact kinds untried and reserves upper setup after either acquisition outcome.
Logical state, mathematical rewards and declared probabilities do not establish physical provider cost, artifact admission, execution timing or durable recovery.

mechanisms.summary: Frozen quote bands transport value/Q bounds, dominance and whole-policy expected regret.
boundaries: Frozen two-kind setup/gross/success bands with natural setup endpoints and exact rational rewards/probabilities. All compatible realizations share nominal upper-setup reservation guards and successor indices; a smaller realized setup never enlarges the action menu.

Value/local-Q enclosures, distinct-competitor dominance and expected adaptive lower-Q policy regret implement Sections 10.1-10.5. Lower-Q maximization is a conservative certified surrogate, not exact minimax; regret is an expected policy-value gap, not a bound on each realized branch.

Protected quote identity admission, artifact-backed gross-saving witnesses, finite-grid calibration and source-generative recorder/recovery certificates remain separate and are not inferred from these bands.

mechanisms.summary: Exact rational binomial cell envelopes and predetermined scheduled selection bounds.
boundaries: No grid-band constructor exists; this algorithm is not Clopper–Pearson or unrestricted anytime calibration.

mechanisms.summary: Immutable terminal events, pending intents and source-generative prefix refinement.
boundaries: Portable snapshots/streams do not implement this sampling lifecycle; physical report-order source integrity is an external premise.

mechanisms.summary: Unconditional bad-issuance bound and censoring/completion-order negative examples.
boundaries: No integrated runtime endpoint composes source laws, schedule, recorder and frozen-policy certificates; a conditional-on-issuance bound would be different.

mechanisms.summary: Checked acknowledgment replay and prepaid durable-upgrade accounting.
boundaries: No AVOC pure journal reducer exists; physical exactly-once execution, durable storage and endpoint authentication remain external even for such a reducer.

mechanisms.summary: Finite rational polynomial moment contraction for atomic/interval/product measures.
boundaries: Built-in finite positive measures and polynomial moments; arbitrary protocol producers are not independently trusted.

mechanisms.summary: Rectangular/singular affine pullback, mass-preserving pushforward, reflection and zero collapse.
boundaries: Density-law replay requires nonzero scale; generic affine pushforward accepts collapse. Oriented integration is separate from positive interval measures.

mechanisms.summary: Basis-witnessed integration rows and contragredient coordinate transport.
boundaries: Finite graded univariate rational polynomial bases with complete witnesses; display labels alone confer no provenance.

mechanisms.summary: Coordinate/scalar fundamental theorem and boundary-retaining integration by parts.
boundaries: Exact univariate polynomials and exact bounded constant-density intervals.

mechanisms.summary: Independent exact direct and iterated product integration in every permitted order.
boundaries: Replay supports homogeneous one-dimensional atomic factors or homogeneous intervals; mixed factors and multidimensional atomic factors are rejected. Permutation enumeration is budgeted.

mechanisms.summary: Signed quadrature functionals with exact consecutive-degree target matching.
boundaries: A matching prefix is a bounded polynomial-space assertion. Exact arithmetic evaluating Q alone supplies no zero target error. Signed weights cannot become a positive measure.

mechanisms.summary: Matched exact polynomial/interval derivative envelope and rational Simpson target-error enclosure.
boundaries: Provider subdivisions must be positive multiples of four. Arithmetic exactness differs from zero target error; floating callable/tensor paths do not receive a rounding enclosure.

mechanisms.summary: Basis-covariant finite quadrature defect row and its exactness kernel.
boundaries: Rows can be assembled from existing APIs, but no dedicated defect-row/kernel certificate producer is exposed.

mechanisms.summary: Polynomial/formal-series adapters and analysis-synthesis integration compatibility.
boundaries: Finite exact coefficient witnesses; integration of derivative providers is finite atomic and inherits provider assumptions.

mechanisms.summary: Replayable exact examples, negative controls and native integration verifier.
boundaries: Repo tests/native verifier are callable; the publication’s 6,866-check archived adversarial script and Lean source execution were not materialized/replayed by this audit.

mechanisms.summary: Normalization kernels, lowering, scalar products and coefficient-domain arithmetic.
boundaries: Finite degree windows and declared domain/unit hypotheses; no arbitrary infinite-sequence theorem prover.

mechanisms.summary: Residue sections and exact normalization-weighted packet transfer.
boundaries: Coefficient identities are exact on finite windows; complex root-filter evaluations are numerical.

mechanisms.summary: Construct coefficient windows from recurrence, rational, implicit algebraic and Euler-product rules.
boundaries: Implicit branch requires a valid initial root and nonzero derivative; generated finite prefixes do not establish analytic continuation.

mechanisms.summary: Bounded exact recurrence/algebraic/P-recursive inference and held-out finite checking.
boundaries: Returned guesses remain finite-data candidates; no all-index proof or unrestricted recognition completeness.

mechanisms.summary: No-borrow digit-local normalized convolution.
boundaries: Declared finite digit tables, radix/modulus and finite audit ranges; arbitrary callbacks are not universally certified.

mechanisms.summary: Integral weighted factorial-power Bell families, digit reduction, parity and bounded-period automata.
boundaries: Digit theorem requires s>=2 and p-1 dividing s-1; certificate comparisons retain selected finite windows.

mechanisms.summary: Unit-series mask construction/inverse and defining Mahler equation replay.
boundaries: Finite truncations over rational coefficients; infinite formal identity is the source theorem, not inferred from a finite replay.

mechanisms.summary: Analytic local-mask products under explicit convergence assumptions.
boundaries: Polynomial masks inside the unit disk, finite products and conservative numerical tails; not directed rounding or general analytic masks.

mechanisms.summary: Finite-mask carry matrices and closure of ordinary digit Cauchy products.
boundaries: Exact finite masks/digit tables with resource guards; does not make every series digit multiplicative.

mechanisms.summary: Carry-layer support counting and prime-power factorial-kernel convolution layers.
boundaries: Carry support and unit residues are distinct; nonzero surviving terms may cancel.

mechanisms.summary: Frobenius-defect masks and first p-adic correction.
boundaries: These two APIs provide exact finite rational mask truncations and a first lift; the complete fixed-precision rational-mask denominator transition is mapped separately under CC.prime_power_cartier.

mechanisms.summary: Polynomial/Euler/cyclotomic coboundary and finite orbit-collapse tests.
boundaries: Polynomial search has declared degree/window bounds; finite cyclotomic exponent input supports exact orbit criteria.

mechanisms.summary: Rational-mask denominator-stabilized Cartier matrices, finite automata and carry equality.
boundaries: Prime modulus only; automaton certificates compare finite prefixes, and algebraic relation replay is finite-degree. Deterministic minimization differs from linear-carrier minimality.

mechanisms.summary: Recursive unit factorial and exact binomial/kernel residues modulo p^r.
boundaries: Exact integer index arithmetic and chosen fixed precision; these are kernel compilers, not rational Mahler-mask Cartier compilers.

mechanisms.summary: Carry-linear valuation profiles and digit-unit normalization.
boundaries: Explicit profile instances are exact; callback classification only audits the declared finite range and cannot establish the universal hypothesis.

mechanisms.summary: Mixed-radix Gaussian-binomial valuations and prime-power support.
boundaries: Integer q and prime/valuation branch hypotheses are checked; no generic symbolic q or finite-state residue compiler.

mechanisms.summary: Residue/polyphase coordinates and normalization-aware signal transfer.
boundaries: Finite signal arrays and finite series; frequency response/stability require separate analytic hypotheses.

mechanisms.summary: Exact nilpotent denominator-layer rational-mask transitions modulo p^r.
boundaries: Fixed positive precision and integer polynomial masks with unit/equal constants modulo p**r; the redundant p*r denominator rectangle is exact. Resource guards constrain coefficient slots, polynomial multiplication pairs, modulus and digit-word length.

No reachable-observable ring-module minimization, arbitrary analytic masks, sharp state bound or canonical cross-precision state morphism. Prefix certificates are bounded software replays, not universal proofs.

mechanisms.summary: Reachable-observable residual module and canonical linear-carrier reduction over nonfields.
boundaries: Bounded complete enumeration over finite free Z/p**r Z ambient presentations; the actual reachable/unobservable quotient has explicit additive/scalar/action laws and may be nonfree. Complete future behavior is computed by stable partition refinement.

No vector-space dimension surrogate, polynomial complexity, abstract infinite module input, canonical coordinate basis, cross-precision maps, automatic adapter for every external Cartier representation, or minimum deterministic automaton claim. Input/enumeration/table/work caps refuse unsupported sizes explicitly.

mechanisms.summary: Finite word-length complete comparison for finite additive p-group carriers.
boundaries: Complete product-orbit comparison over the same prime-power ring and finite ordered alphabet for free realizations and their explicit nonfree residual quotients; exact additive cardinalities determine the strict b+c word-length horizon and a mismatch returns a shortest distinguishing word.

No infinite alphabet input, arbitrary externally supplied abstract module table adapter, field-rank shortcut, selected-integer-only equivalence, or polynomial bit complexity. Product carrier and estimated work are preflighted; a refusal is never equality.

mechanisms.summary: Split analysis/synthesis, compatible kernels and exact encode/decode composition.
boundaries: Exact finite rational specializations; general semiring-module theorem is not an executable generic proof.

mechanisms.summary: Hidden-return compression defect and two-stage coherence.
boundaries: Exact defect helper requires orthogonal rational retained projections; arbitrary oblique split C,R and a dedicated coherence certificate are absent.

mechanisms.summary: Compatibility kernel modulo actual source range, realization and quotient transport.
boundaries: Exact SymPy finite cokernel computations are present; no integrated presentation (A,delta) constructor for ker(delta)/range(A) and full quotient functor is exposed.

mechanisms.summary: Exact hidden-state memory and initial hidden forcing derived from actual powers.
boundaries: Finite rational orthogonal split and declared horizon; not arbitrary ring/oblique split or an infinite-tail rollout claim.

mechanisms.summary: Finite hidden moments decide all-depth prepared closure.
boundaries: Feshbach moment acceptance is numerical/tolerance-based. Exact finite kernels exist, but no dedicated rational arbitrary-split all-depth closure producer is exposed. Prepared and arbitrary-hidden initialization differ.

mechanisms.summary: All-future invisible state, plateau certificates and minimum exact behavioral coordinates.
boundaries: Exact finite rational dual row-space construction for known finite operator alphabets; delay closure is single-operator. Round-capped incomplete runs are not certified minimal. No general ring-module or abstract competitor-proof engine.

mechanisms.summary: Word-defect transport and heterogeneous/two-rate continuation error budgets.
boundaries: Single-matrix power bounds and operator transfer pieces exist; no complete multi-letter q/intertwining budget constructor for all SR-13–16 contracts.

mechanisms.summary: Bounded flow variation-of-constants, exact hidden memory and finite jets.
boundaries: Finite matrix exponential/resolvent computations are numerical; not universal Banach-space exponential identities or an exact continuous certificate.

mechanisms.summary: Duhamel generator-defect transport and response/stability bounds.
boundaries: Finite matrices, numerical integration and declared envelope inputs; no derivation of unknown process bounds or all Banach generator contracts.

mechanisms.summary: Three-way realized/compatible-obstruction/incompatible decomposition with conditioning.
boundaries: Runtime computes numerical image/cokernel projections with retained SVD rank; it does not construct the full nested range(A)<=ker(delta) geometry or certify sharp conditioning constants.

mechanisms.summary: Canonical minimum-norm source, source/kernel ambiguity and closed-range conditioning.
boundaries: Finite numerical pseudoinverse shares a retained SVD rank model; exact canonical dual only covers full-column-rank finite frames. No infinite closed-range constructor or dedicated source-conditioning certificate.

mechanisms.summary: Native quotient norm/harmonic isometry, minimum representatives and metric refinement.
boundaries: Redundant coefficient metrics are present; no full globalization quotient metric/transport producer. Nonclosed quotient boundaries are theoretical and cannot be modeled by a finite rank test.

mechanisms.summary: Positive normal inverse, objective increment, bias/noise/kernel and parameter/operator sensitivity.
boundaries: Exact positive normal inverse, objective increment, whole-map bounds, kernel bias/noise split, checked source coercivity/source condition and checked two-operator sensitivity are implemented in finite rational Euclidean spaces.

SR-40's intrinsic globalization obstruction/inconsistency decomposition and a dedicated canonical-inverse bias interface are not implemented here; infinite Hilbert constructors and strong limits remain outside this finite API.
Nonorthogonal or redundant coordinate metrics must be transported before this Euclidean interface applies; no metric is inferred from raw coordinates.

mechanisms.summary: Strong identifiable-source limits and the closed-range uniform boundary.
boundaries: Finite parameter sweeps cannot prove filter limits, density statements or infinite nonclosed-range boundaries.

mechanisms.summary: Actual residual curve, unique interior discrepancy parameter and total small-data acceptance.
boundaries: Finite exact residual evaluation, full attainable-floor computation, strict root endpoints and rational root brackets are implemented; the total finite selector returns zero or an actual rational source inside the accepted band.
A real root such as 1+sqrt(2) is only bracketed; the paper's exact noncomputable upper-edge selected witness is not claimed as a rational algorithm output.
The positive selector checks finite floor<=eta; the small-data branch checks its defining inequality only. Neither authenticates true data noise or proves infinite-family consistency.

mechanisms.summary: Actual normal residual, source/image correction scales and squared protected discrepancy certificates.
boundaries: Finite rational pointwise sector: actual normal residual, distinct source/image correction scales, protected scalar window and every signed/nonnegative squared SR-52 premise are recomputed.
Solver-reported squared norms are not accepted in place of actual matrix expressions; a false zero residual or incorrect evaluation enclosure invalidates the record.
The record leaves genuine true-data allowances and infinite-family convergence premises unchecked. It does not replay source Lean structures or authenticate measurement truth.

mechanisms.summary: Whole-operator model allowance, transported normal residuals and changing-kernel consistency.
boundaries: Runtime does not bind true and available model contracts into discrepancy certificates; whole-operator allowances cannot be inferred from a single fitted sample.

mechanisms.summary: Candidate-dependent acceptance, feasibility margin and zero-model negative control.
boundaries: Finite cap-free candidate acceptance, exact nonsquare-norm comparisons, actual normal-source verification, feasible-comparison norm domination, strict relative scalar margin and the zero-model negative control are implemented.

Truth/operator bounds remain separate premises; the module does not bind a true and available operator to the conditional existence/consistency chain or extract the source's noncomputable selected family.
A small fitting residual or an upper candidate-noise inequality alone cannot qualify an approximate source as the actual regularized candidate.

mechanisms.summary: Split/hierarchical/approximate calibration frames generate whole-operator allowances.
boundaries: Finite split frame algebra is implemented, but no measurement-bound/analysis-norm/strict-defect certificate produces the recovery allowance. Full source-direction coverage and calibration-truth bounds remain separate inputs.
